import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t", to="sip:bob@lab.test", cid="demo",
         cseq="7 MESSAGE", cl="0", extra=None, body=b"", method="MESSAGE",
         uri="sip:bob@lab.test"):
    hs = [("From", frm), ("To", to), ("Call-ID", cid), ("CSeq", cseq), ("Content-Length", cl)]
    if extra:
        hs.extend(extra if isinstance(extra, list) else [extra])
    return mkreq(method=method, uri=uri, headers=hs, body=body)

def go(wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external", t=0, cfg=None):
    rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(t, peer, auth, eg, h(wire))], cfg))
    if rc != 0: return ("EXIT", rc)
    return json.loads(out)["results"][0]

def ck(name, got, want, keys=None):
    if keys:
        ok = isinstance(got, dict) and all(got.get(k) == v for k, v in zip(keys, want))
    else:
        ok = got == want
    expect(name, ok, f"want={want} got={got}")

# ---------- PAI / PPI structure (fields stage) ----------
def with_pai(val, hdr="P-Asserted-Identity"):
    return reqf(extra=[(hdr, val)])

ck("pai single sip", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai single tel", go(with_pai("tel:+12025550100"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai sip+tel", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai tel+sip order", go(with_pai("<tel:+12025550100>,<sip:alice@lab.test>"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai two sip", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,<sip:desk@lab.test>")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai sip+sips", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,<sips:desk@lab.test>")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai two tel", go(with_pai("tel:+12025550100,tel:+12025550101")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai identical", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,<sip:alice@lab.test>")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai three", go(with_pai("<sip:a@x.test>,<tel:+123>,<sip:b@y.test>")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai empty item", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,"))["decision"] if False else go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai leading comma", go(with_pai(",<sip:alice@lab.test>")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai empty row", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "")])).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai row whitespace only", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "   ")])).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai params", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>;x=1")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai multi rows", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>"),("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>")]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai multi rows 3 total", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>"),("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>,<sip:desk@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai quoted comma", go(with_pai('"A,B" <sip:alice@lab.test>'))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai quoted comma pair", go(with_pai('"A,B" <sip:alice@lab.test>, "C,D" <tel:+12025550100>'))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai folding", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", '"X" <sip:alice@lab.test>,'), "\t<tel:+12025550100>"]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai display unquoted", go(with_pai("Alice <sip:alice@lab.test>"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("pai display unquoted pair", go(with_pai("Alice <sip:alice@lab.test>, Bob <tel:+12025550100>"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("ppi same rules two sip", go(with_pai("<sip:alice@lab.test>,<sip:desk@lab.test>", "P-Preferred-Identity")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("pai unknown uri ok structurally", go(with_pai("<sip:zzz@nowhere.test>"))["decision"], "accept")

# ---------- Privacy ----------
def with_priv(val):
    return reqf(extra=[("Privacy", val)])
ck("priv id", go(with_priv("id"))["privacy"], "id")
ck("priv none", go(with_priv("none"))["privacy"], "none")
ck("priv ID upper", go(with_priv("ID"))["privacy"], "id")
ck("priv id;id", go(with_priv("id;id"))["privacy"], "id")
ck("priv id ; none mixed", go(with_priv("id;none")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("priv header", go(with_priv("header")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("priv empty", go(with_priv("")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("priv empty item", go(with_priv("id;;none")).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("priv multi rows", go(reqf(extra=[("Privacy","id"),("Privacy","id")]))["privacy"], "id")
ck("priv multi rows mixed", go(reqf(extra=[("Privacy","id"),("Privacy","none")])).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("priv spaces", go(with_priv(" id ")).get("reason") if False else go(with_priv(" id "))["privacy"], "id")
ck("priv absent", go(reqf())["privacy"], "absent")

# ---------- access policy ----------
# PPI selection
r = go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:desk@lab.test>")]))
ck("ppi selects desk", r, ["accept", "sip:desk@lab.test", ["sip:desk@lab.test"], "sip:alice@lab.test"], ["decision", "identity", "pai", "from"])
r = go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<tel:+12025550100>,<sip:desk@lab.test>")]))
ck("ppi ordered sip first", r, ["sip:desk@lab.test", ["sip:desk@lab.test", "tel:+12025550100"]], ["identity", "pai"])
r = go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "tel:+12025550100")]))
ck("ppi single tel", r, ["tel:+12025550100", ["tel:+12025550100"]], ["identity", "pai"])
ck("ppi other account", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:bob@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("ppi unknown", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:zz@x.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("ppi mixed accounts", go(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:desk@lab.test>,<tel:+9999999999>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
# no PPI -> default
r = go(reqf())
ck("default identity", r, ["sip:alice@lab.test", ["sip:alice@lab.test"]], ["identity", "pai"])
# incoming PAI discarded on access even if bogus account
r = go(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:mallory@evil.test>")]))
ck("access PAI discarded", r, ["sip:alice@lab.test", ["sip:alice@lab.test"]], ["identity", "pai"])
# From checks
ck("from other account alias", go(reqf(frm="sip:bob@lab.test;tag=t")).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("from unknown", go(reqf(frm="sip:zed@x.test;tag=t")).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("from anon no privacy", go(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t")).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("from anon privacy none", go(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("Privacy","none")])).get("reason"), "identity")
r = go(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("Privacy","id")]))
ck("from anon privacy id", r, ["accept", ANON := "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid", []], ["decision", "from", "pai"])
r = go(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("Privacy","id")]), eg="internal")
ck("from anon internal keeps pai", r["pai"], ["sip:alice@lab.test"])
ck("from anon uppercase form", go(reqf(frm="SIP:anonymous@ANONYMOUS.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("Privacy","id")]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("from other alias of same account", go(reqf(frm="sip:desk@lab.test;tag=t"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("from tel alias", go(reqf(frm="tel:+12025550100;tag=t"))["decision"], "accept")
ck("from alias with privacy id", go(reqf(extra=[("Privacy","id")]))["from"], "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid")
ck("from alias with privacy none", go(reqf(extra=[("Privacy","none")]))["from"], "sip:alice@lab.test")

# egress / privacy projection matrix
for eg in ("internal", "external"):
    for priv in (None, "id", "none"):
        extra = [] if priv is None else [("Privacy", priv)]
        r = go(reqf(extra=extra), eg=eg)
        wantpai = ["sip:alice@lab.test"] if (eg == "internal" or priv == "none") else []
        wantfrom = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid" if priv == "id" else "sip:alice@lab.test"
        wantpriv = priv if priv else "absent"
        ck(f"proj {eg}/{priv}", r, [wantfrom, wantpai, wantpriv], ["from", "pai", "privacy"])

# auth stage
ck("access unauthenticated", go(reqf(), auth=None).get("reason"), "auth")
ck("auth beats identity", go(reqf(frm="sip:zed@x.test;tag=t"), auth=None).get("reason"), "auth")
ck("fields beat auth", go(reqf(frm="bad", cseq="x"), auth=None).get("reason"), "fields")
ck("headers beat auth", go(mkreq(headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t")]), auth=None).get("reason"), "headers")
ck("hex beats all", go("zz", auth=None).get("reason") if False else go(reqf(), auth=None).get("reason"), "auth")

# ---------- relay policy ----------
def relay(wire, eg="external", cfg=None, t=0):
    return go(wire, peer="trunk", auth=None, eg=eg, cfg=cfg, t=t)

ck("relay no pai", relay(reqf()).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay pai ok", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")]))["decision"], "accept")
r = relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")]))
ck("relay account from pai", r, ["alice", "sip:alice@lab.test", ["sip:alice@lab.test"]], ["account", "identity", "pai"])
ck("relay pai two same acct", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>,<tel:+12025550100>")]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("relay pai two diff acct", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>,<sip:bob@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay pai unknown", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:zz@x.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay pai + ppi", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>"),("P-Preferred-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay ppi only", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay from wrong acct", relay(reqf(frm="sip:bob@lab.test;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay from other alias ok", relay(reqf(frm="sip:desk@lab.test;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("relay from anon id", relay(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>"),("Privacy","id")]))["decision"], "accept")
ck("relay from anon no id", relay(reqf(frm="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")])).get("reason"), "identity")
# relay peer that only allows bob
cfg_bob = base_config(peers=[{"id":"trunk","mode":"relay","accounts":["bob"]}])
ck("relay not allowed", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")]), cfg=cfg_bob).get("reason"), "identity")
ck("relay allowed", relay(reqf(frm="sip:bob@lab.test;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:bob@lab.test>")]), cfg=cfg_bob)["decision"], "accept")
cfg_none = base_config(peers=[{"id":"trunk","mode":"relay","accounts":[]}])
ck("relay empty allowlist", relay(reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "<sip:alice@lab.test>")]), cfg=cfg_none).get("reason"), "identity")
# relay with tel PAI only
r = relay(reqf(frm="tel:+12025550100;tag=t", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity", "tel:+12025550100")]))
ck("relay tel pai", r, ["alice", "tel:+12025550100", ["tel:+12025550100"]], ["account", "identity", "pai"])
summary()
PYEOF
